title: Real Madrid sends condolences to Colombia after earthquake
seoTitle: Real Madrid sends condolences to Colombia after earthquake
subtitle: European clubs express solidarity after quake that left over 80 dead
excerpt: On August 10, 2026, a powerful earthquake struck Colombia, killing over 80. Real Madrid and Tottenham Hotspur posted messages of support and condolences.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On August 10, 2026, Colombia was shaken by a high‑magnitude earthquake that, according to preliminary information, has already claimed more than 80 lives in the departments of Risaralda, Valle del Cauca, Caldas and Chocó. In the wake of the tragedy, Real Madrid – a club that has featured Colombian players such as James Rodríguez, Freddy Rincón, Edwin Congo and, currently, Linda Caicedo in women’s football – issued a statement of condolences.

Real Madrid mourns the tragedy

The official statement from Real Madrid C.F., signed by the president and the Board of Directors, expressed sorrow for the victims’ families and for the entire Colombian people. “From Real Madrid we want to extend our solidarity and we wish a swift recovery for the injured, to whom we send all our affection,” the message read.

President Florentino Pérez participates in the message

The message was issued under the leadership of President Florentino Pérez, who, together with the club’s board, reiterated the commitment to send support and solidarity to the affected country.

Club reinforces ties with Colombia

By highlighting the shared history, the club emphasized that Colombian football has long been represented in its ranks, citing players who have been part of the team over the years, including the current women’s team star, Linda Caicedo.

Tottenham Hotspur also joins the support

Tottenham Hotspur, the English club where Colombian Dávinson Sánchez played, posted a support message on its X account. “From Tottenham Hotspur we want to send a message of solidarity and support to all the people of Colombia after today’s earthquake. Our thoughts and best wishes are with those affected, their families and the entire Colombian community at this time. Stay strong!” the team wrote.

International solidarity in the face of the emergency

The statements from both clubs demonstrate a gesture of support and empathy, reinforcing the sporting and human connection between the institutions and the Colombian people who are facing the crisis caused by the quake.

With information from El Colombiano.
